Kinda hacky, but When I need to use a new wifi network, or transfer from wired to wireless, or vice versa... This is my process:

plug in cable/get wifi menu to generate profile.

routef to flush the route table

cycle the net - ip link set <yournet> down/up.

setting it to up again will reconfigure my route table properly to use the right gateway... hacky but it works for me.
